outcome: Postpartum cerebrovascular disease (cerebral infarction, intracranial hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage)
cohort: 3,611,216 Korean women who delivered between 2007 and 2014, including 412 women with Moyamoya disease and 1420 age- and parity-matched controls
finding: Women with Moyamoya disease had a significantly higher risk of developing postpartum cerebrovascular disease within 2.3 years after delivery compared to women without Moyamoya disease.
mod_finding: Women with Moyamoya disease who gave birth had a significantly higher rate of Cesarean section compared to the control group.
